summary: GemAir's own brain, on your machine: the opencode agent, pointed at free models.

setupSteps.title: Node.js 20 or newer
setupSteps.body: opencode installs through npm, so Node has to be there first. GemAir can install it for you if it is missing.

steps.title: Install opencode
steps.body: One global npm package. No account, no card.

steps.title: Check opencode answers
steps.body: A version means it is installed and on PATH.

steps.title: Pick a free model provider
steps.body: Run `opencode auth login` and choose OpenCode Zen. Its free model ids end in -free, and GemAir will not use any other kind. You can skip this entirely — GemAir talks to Zen's free models on its own.

steps.title: Ask it something
steps.body: A one-word answer proves the CLI, the provider and the model are all wired up.
steps.command: opencode run "reply with the single word: ready"
